title: BMAD Stepper Config
description: Project configuration for prompt-first BMAD Stepper. BMAD Method is a prerequisite and is not installed by Stepper.

configPath.description: Path to the target project's existing BMAD Method config, commonly _bmad/core/config.yaml.

optionalSteps.description: Default optional-step policy. V1 commands include optional BMAD steps unless --skip-optional is requested.

taskOutputs.description: Validation policy for declared task outputs before a step can advance.

mutationScope.description: Validation policy for file changes against declared allowed paths.

onOutOfScopeMutation.description: Unexpected mutations stop or require explicit user approval.

recovery.description: Prompt-first recovery behavior for conflicts, reconcile, diagnostics, and interrupted runs.

stateEvidenceComparison.description: State must be compared with artifact evidence before downstream work is selected.

reconcileRequiresConfirmation.description: State or artifact repair is never applied automatically.

idempotentReentry.description: Re-entry reuses proven artifacts and retries only unproven outputs.

conflictPolicy.description: State/artifact conflicts require interactive repair before continuation.

loopSummariesDir.description: Directory for loop summaries and stop reports written by /bmad-loop.

reconcileReportsDir.description: Directory for user-confirmed reconcile reports and repair records.

diagnosticsDir.description: Directory for read-only diagnostic reports when conflicts or interrupted runs are inspected.

recordReviewFixHistory.description: Run records and story artifacts preserve review/fix history.

maxReviewIterations.description: Default review/fix iteration cap for prompt-first records.

plugin.description: Project-pinned Stepper behavior and update protection for command specs, schemas, templates, and docs.

pinnedVersion.description: Stepper version this project expects. Commands should explain when global plugin behavior differs from this project pin.

updatePolicy.description: Default policy for project asset updates.

detectLocalChanges.description: Detect project-local edits before any Stepper asset is overwritten.

distinguishChangeSources.description: Classify differences as upstream plugin changes, project-local changes, or both.

changePlanRequired.description: Show the planned asset changes before mutation.

overwriteRequiresConfirmation.description: Require explicit user confirmation before overwriting project-pinned assets.
